tokscale_window: Tokscale only publishes the last 12 months.
note_tagline: Notes, todos and calendar that sync across your devices
note_unreleased: No release yet. Build it from the source in the meantime.
note_feature_canvas_body: Lay out text cards and whole notes on a JSON Canvas board, then connect them with arrows and gather them into groups.
note_feature_plan_body: A month calendar with repeating events next to a todo board that reads dates, tags and priorities as you type.
note_feature_sync_body: Pair devices with a code and sync them directly, without an account or a sync server.
note_feature_eris_body: Calendar events sync with the Eris panel, and notes cited in an event open straight in Note.
note_shot_editor: Note editor with the file tree, live preview and backlinks
note_feature_graph_body: Every wikilink becomes an edge. See which notes hold your vault together and jump along the connections.
note_feature_mobile_body: The same vault on your desk and in your pocket, with a layout that fits each screen.
note_feature_palette_body: Every action sits in the command palette, with shortcuts for new notes, quick switching and search.
note_more_preview_body: Markdown renders in place while you write.
note_more_links_body: Link notes by name and see everything that points back.
note_more_outline_body: Jump between the headings of a long note.
note_more_templates_body: Start a note from your own template folder.
note_more_search_body: Find any text across the vault.
note_more_splits_body: Open notes side by side and drag panels where you want them.
note_more_html_body: Run HTML and scripts inside a note, walled off from the app.
note_more_themes_body: Follow the system theme or pick one.
note_more_files_body: Notes stay .md files in your folder, readable by anything.
